sentences.text: IPMA has issued a yellow warning for rough sea in the Faro district, valid from 17:19 on 2026-11-18 to 09:00 on 2026-11-20, local time.
On 2026-11-19, waves on the Sagres coast are forecast at 3.3 to 3.8 metres from NW, with sea temperature 19 to 19.1 °C.
On 2026-11-19, waves on the Faro coast are forecast at 0.7 to 1.3 metres from W, with sea temperature 19.2 to 19.7 °C.
Rain is forecast at 100% today in Faro, Portimão, Loulé and Sagres.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-19, rain is forecast at 0% in Faro, Portimão, Loulé and Sagres.
